plan: Log into SupplyHub vendor portal and locate invoices issued by Globex Industries.
Determine the latest invoice by comparing invoice dates, and extract the invoice number, total payable amount, and due date.
Log into Acme ERP using the ops.agent service account.
Verify that Globex Industries exists in the ERP vendor master.
Check the ERP AP list to ensure the invoice number is not already recorded.
Format the due date as DD-MM-YYYY and amount as a plain number.
Check the approval threshold; if amount >= INR 50,000, request manager approval prior to submission.
Submit the AP invoice entry with category 'Raw Materials' and note 'Recorded by AI operator from SupplyHub'.
Notify the requester with the confirmation and recorded invoice details.
relevant_policies: Latest invoice definition: invoice with the most recent invoice date on SupplyHub (not highest number or first row).
Duplicate prevention: check AP list first - never record an invoice that is already recorded.
Formatting rules: invoice number exact match; amount as plain number (no commas/symbols); due date as DD-MM-YYYY.
Expense category: Globex Industries maps to 'Raw Materials'.
Mandatory note: 'Recorded by AI operator from SupplyHub'.
Vendor master prerequisite: supplier must already exist in vendor master; do not create vendor without procurement onboarding request, escalate if missing.
Approval policy: any AP invoice with amount >= INR 50,000 requires manager approval before submission.
risks: Invoice amount may equal or exceed INR 50,000, requiring manager approval before submission.
The invoice may already be recorded in ERP AP, which requires halting to prevent duplicate payment.
Globex Industries might not exist in the ERP vendor master, requiring human escalation rather than automated creation.
Date format on SupplyHub may differ and require careful parsing to avoid entering an incorrect DD-MM-YYYY due date.
